node.statement: Combining 1.1--1.4, each quotient trace in the trace sum is (-1)^k dim_reals(W_p/W_{p+1}), and the quotient dimensions sum to dim_reals V. Hence Tr(sigma^{*k}:H^k(M;reals)->H^k(M;reals))=(-1)^k dim_reals H^k(M;reals); since k >= 0 was arbitrary, this proves the root claim for every k.
